description: Family names and query kinds cannot evade recursive-query detection (engine §2.2, §4, and §10).
grammar:
%rule text X
%conditions $.without-elision-except(fam).begins(a)
%rule a X :: R
%conditions $.without-elision.tags(b) = R
%rule b X :: R
%conditions $.without-elision-except(other).begins(a)
%rule fam a
%rule other b
